name: v0.27.0
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(pi): expose max output tokens and context window for custom endpoints by @ccurme in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4297
* fix(trial): record an interrupted trial as cancelled by @praneethprathi in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4212
* docs: announce Harbor Server on the news page by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4300
* fix(antigravity): invoke SDK runner via uv run, honor version, and drop stdbuf by @kibergus in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4263
* docs: add v0.26.0 changelog highlights by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4306
* docs: add subtle latest news banners by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4332
* fix(docs): restore clickable navigation below news banner by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4337
* fix(langsmith): make sandboxes reliable for long agent runs by @ccurme in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4295
* feat(langgraph): write ATIF trajectory and forward skills by @ccurme in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4296
* fix(computer-1): Claude computer toolset, tier-aware sizing, and Gemini 4 on the desktop environment by @erikqu in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4340
* fix(daytona): cap the daytona SDK below 1.0 by @mislavivanda in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4331
* fix(claude-code): use the native installer on Alpine by @tgreenwood in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4335
* feat(antigravity-sdk): add system_instructions option by @miguelrc-scale in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4341
* Install the standalone Harbor API SDK by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4139
* Move CLI artifact workflows to API-managed SDK transfers by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4209
* Replace Hub and registry database calls with native SDK resources by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4140
* Complete hosted, credentials and authentication SDK migration by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4216
* Default hosted gateway launches to automatic concurrency by @vancenate in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4338
* fix(daytona): extract uploaded archives with --no-same-owner by @Vedant-Agarwal in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2043
* docs: fix typos by @GDemay in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3623
* fix(dataset): reject negative n_tasks by @rudycelekli in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3875
* Point the task template at reward.json, the file the verifier reads by @DennisTraub in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2533
* fix(fabric): preserve model configuration and validate task setup by @AjayThorve in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4054
* fix(pi): send the task prompt on stdin so leading-dash instructions aren't parsed as flags by @davidh- in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2963
* docs: use app.ppapi.ai in parity API examples by @audreina17 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4165
* fix: format ExceptionInfo traceback from the passed exception by @JoyboyBrian in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2412
* fix(grok-build): keep streaming-json out of exec stdout by @vietnnguyen in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4380
* fix(oracle): raise NonZeroAgentExitCodeError on failed solutions by @JoyboyBrian in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4381
* Move the CLI to harbor-framework-client 0.2.0 cursor pagination by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4384
* fix(agents): accept medium reasoning effort on non-Flash Gemini models by @jw-surge in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4206
* feat(opencode-v2): add codemode option for task MCP servers by @jw-surge in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4207
* fix(opencode-v2): survive trajectory conversion errors by @jw-surge in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4382
* fix(openclaw): support google/* model names and shared Gemini env aliases by @k3nnethfrancis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4383
* Document OAuth MCP setup for Harbor Hub by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4402
* fix(e2b): survive concurrent builds of the same new template by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4355
* Update Harbor SDK to 0.3.0 by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4417

## New Contributors
* @ccurme made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4297
* @kibergus made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4263
* @mislavivanda made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4331
* @tgreenwood made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4335
* @GDemay made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3623
* @rudycelekli made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3875
* @DennisTraub made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2533
* @davidh- made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2963
* @audreina17 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4165
* @JoyboyBrian made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2412
* @jw-surge made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4206
* @k3nnethfrancis made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4383

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/compare/v0.26.0...v0.27.0
